tasks.label: Compile PDF
tasks.detail: latexmk -pdfxe (same as CI); falls back to a TeX Live container if latexmk is not installed
tasks.command: if command -v latexmk >/dev/null; then latexmk -pdfxe -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex; else ${CONTAINER_ENGINE:-$(command -v podman || command -v docker)} run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}":/workdir:Z -w /workdir docker.io/texlive/texlive:latest latexmk -pdfxe -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex; fi

tasks.label: Clean LaTeX build files
tasks.command: if command -v latexmk >/dev/null; then latexmk -C main.tex; else rm -f main.aux main.log main.out main.pdf main.fls main.fdb_latexmk main.xdv main.synctex.gz; fi
